title: Unified Tool Discovery Consensus
summary: Consensus reached to treat local Python tools and remote MCP tools as a single Tactical Library.
key_findings: Local tools are prioritized for internal diagnostics (Geordi/Data).
External registries (Smithery) are used for dynamic scaling of agent capabilities.
Worf mandates vetting for all dynamically discovered server.json schemas.
conclusions: Expose all Python scripts in apps/api/mcp-server.js as standard MCP tools.
Agents are instructed to search registries if local tools fail to meet mission goals.
The 'MCP Envelope' now contains both verified local and verified remote endpoints.
